rubric_items.reason: Every ticket ask (AC1-AC8) becomes a requirement. Undefined glossary terms and the PRD references are listed under Out of scope with reasons.
AC3 is split into one requirement per excluded group and each one can be tested. REQ-12 and REQ-13 give different scopes for the single AC8 rule, and nothing explains why.
Each requirement cites its ticket line. REQ-13 narrows AC8's scope but is still marked known. The Summary claims there is an existing HMS-21 implementation and gives no citation.
The glossary period rule says dashboard tiles follow the period. The artifact notes that this tile does not, but it never raises the clash as a question with both cites.
No questions are asked and most asks are stated directly. The scope of the AC8 'no contact details' rule for the linked list was decided without asking.
The wording is plain and glossary terms are used consistently. One small inconsistency: the period glossary entry does not cover this tile.
